label: Five-star restaurants
note: Pay the most for top grade and provenance.

label: Hotels and banquet kitchens
note: Larger orders than restaurants, slower to pay.

label: Grocery chains
note: Large steady orders at near-wholesale prices.

label: Processors
note: Reliable volume buyer for anything that meets basic grade.

label: Export buyers
note: Pay for bulk of high grade; long payment terms.

label: Direct to shoppers
note: Best price per pound but small volumes and selling time.
